text:
anya: Quick sync — sketching a proposal to collapse 'Models' + 'Deployments' into a single left-rail group called 'Serving'. Also thinking we should surface the workspace slug in breadcrumbs for better deep-linking. Posting a tiny URL map + a few questions.

mike: Quick Q — collapsing sounds good for scan, but what about existing bookmarks/links? We need a redirect/migration plan.

anya: Yep — plan is to preserve old routes as aliases. Server-side 301s for external links and client-side replaceState redirects in-console during the migration window.

julie: From a UX POV fewer top-level items is cleaner. Concern: grouping could hide commonly used actions. Suggest we keep a slim divider and a small label "Serving" with collapsible affordance.

samir: Routing nit — if we move to canonical /org/:org/ws/:ws/serving/:section, the back button behaviour matters. In some current flows pushing history for sub-panel opens causes scroll-to-top and losing scroll/restoration. Do we prefer path segments (pushState) or hash anchors for internal panel nav?

anya: Recommendation: prefer path segments (pushState) so deep links are shareable/bookmarkable. We'll implement a scroll/restoration snapshot for list pages, and use history.replaceState during ephemeral UI interactions (tours, modals) so users don't get swamped.

rachel: Accessibility: on route changes we must send an aria-live announcement for the new page title and programmatically focus the main content region. For breadcrumbs, truncated items should expose full text via aria-label and a tooltip.

mike: Implementation sketch of canonical routes (very rough):

```
# canonical routes
/organisations/:orgSlug/workspaces/:wsSlug/serving/models
/organisations/:orgSlug/workspaces/:wsSlug/serving/deployments
/organisations/:orgSlug/workspaces/:wsSlug/serving/overview

# old aliases (to stay working during migration)
/organisations/:orgSlug/workspaces/:wsSlug/models  -> redirect 301 -> /.../serving/models
/organisations/:orgSlug/workspaces/:wsSlug/deployments -> redirect 301 -> /.../serving/deployments
```

julie: :thumbsup: Also think about microcopy for the collapsed group — maybe "Serving (models & deployments)" while we transition.

design-bot: Deploy preview for the left-rail reorg is live on canary: https://canary.console.redwood.ai/serving-preview :rocket:

julie: Looks promising. Can we add a small expand/collapse animation to make the grouping change feel less jarring?

anya: Yes — subtle motion, 120ms ease-out. Also need product sign-off on metric goals: reduce click-to-open time and surface fewer top-level items. cc @samir for instrumentation.

samir: I'll add telemetry: route change duration, bookmark usage, alias hit-rate, and a feature-flagged revert path.

mike: Don't forget to update the deep-link generator in the SDK and the docs (changelog + migration guide).

anya: I'll draft the copy for breadcrumb updates and open a small PR for wording + the aria-live strings. Thanks, everyone — will follow up with a short design mock and the URL mapping spreadsheet.
_reserved: do not add extra nested fields
